13.7Mobservations in the difference-in-differences panel
№ 001 Working paper Econometrics · Industrial organization

Did the United–Continental merger hurt consumers?

A difference-in-differences analysis of 13.7 million observations finds a small, statistically significant decline in fares — the merger did not harm consumer welfare.
